findings.text: No candidate resembles the paint-by-number field, where nearly every icon is a lush flower, pixel heart or pumpkin with outlined numbered cells; the calm flat palettes alone stand apart there.
[D]: a white crescent on dark navy sits almost exactly beside Sleep Sounds - R... and Sleep: Sounds & ... in the sleep row; the small '3' is the only thing separating it from a sleep app.
[C]: a night sky with crescent and stars over purple hills reads like the sleep row (Sleep Sounds - R..., Sleep Sounds Whi...), and its tiny '4' is nearly invisible, so it says sleep before paint.
[B]: the moon is drawn as a paint-by-number shape with purple patches and a numeral '4' inside a cell, which no rival or sleep icon does; the moon becomes the canvas, so it is distinctly ours.
[A]: the big '6' on cream hills is unlike any rival icon, but 'Paint by Heart' sits close to Paint Your World and the many heart icons in the color-by-number rows, and the icon shows no heart.
[B], [C], [D] share 'Paint by Moonlight', which no rival name resembles, while every rival name leans on 'Paint by Number'; the name is owned, the icon has to carry the painting.
